task.title: L12.22 protected-diagnosis residuals: audit on a throwing provider, shadow-root blind spot, child-frame ceiling
task.objective: Owner request of 2026-10-05: implement awkit-djnl.21.22. Reproduce each residual on current main, classify it, add red-first deterministic coverage for real defects and fix them minimally: (1) a protected read whose provider throws must still write PROTECTED_DIAGNOSIS_USED; (2) refused wording, a challenge widget or a password field rendered only inside a shadow root must not be missed by the detector or the snapshot serializer, so the Recorder still pauses and the diagnosis still refuses; (3) the child-frame override ceiling is classified. CAPTCHA, MFA, OTP, passkey, device approval and bot-detection are never automated; protected login stays on the manual handoff and session-reuse path. L12.23 and L12.24 are not reopened.

acceptance.description: A protected read whose provider call throws still reports the read for the PROTECTED_DIAGNOSIS_USED audit, proven on a real page in verify:protected-diagnosis, and the IPC writes the audit through that report rather than after diagnose returns.

A password field, a challenge widget or refused wording inside an open shadow root (at any depth), and a challenge iframe inside a closed shadow root, make the detector pause and the serializer refuse, with controls showing ordinary shadow content is not refused; a shadow-root sign-in on the mock site pauses the live Recorder.
Element Spy, diagnosis, recovery, runner, session, mock-site, build, script typecheck and verifier classification stay green.

completion.qa_known_limitations: Wording inside a closed shadow root is unreadable. Detection runs on load and DOMContentLoaded only, so a sign-in rendered or framed later without a navigation is not re-checked (from the code, not reproduced). A framed sign-in never gets the Super-User diagnosis override (fail closed by design).
